about: MIDI songs used as inputs. The files are fan-made sequences by third parties: they stay out of git in data/raw/ and `uv run src/main.py fetch` downloads them and checks each SHA-256. The committed ABC lead sheets in data/leadsheets/ are this project's reduction of each song (melody track, detected chords, part labels), written by `uv run src/main.py abc --all`, so the arranger can rerun even if a site goes away. `midi` holds the lead-sheet settings of the sample that used the song (config key `midi`).

songs.title: Voa Voa
songs.note: Collected by the student from the description of a YouTube video; the file's track names say 'Editado Por: Fernando' and 2014. The committed ABC lead sheet is the input a fresh clone uses.

songs.title: Mulher de Fases
songs.note: From Beatriz Kauffmann's Web Site, a non-commercial site of MPB MIDI sequences. The file's own text says 'Copyright © 2000 by Editora Zardo Ltda.' (Play Music).

songs.title: Amor I Love You
songs.note: From Beatriz Kauffmann's Web Site, a non-commercial site of MPB MIDI sequences. The file's own text says 'Copyright © 2000 by Editora Zardo Ltda.' (Play Music).

songs.title: Por Você
songs.note: From Beatriz Kauffmann's Web Site, a non-commercial site of MPB MIDI sequences; neither the page nor the file names the sequencer. Saved as por_voce_bk.mid to tell it from another sequence of the same song.

songs.title: Fico Assim Sem Você
songs.note: From Beatriz Kauffmann's Web Site, a non-commercial site of MPB MIDI sequences. The page names Claudinho & Buchecha as the reference recording; the file's own text names Adriana Calcanhotto's version, the sequencer Marcos Borelli and 'Copyright © Editora HMP'.

songs.title: Aquarela
songs.note: From BitMidi, a site of user-uploaded MIDI files (file id 7390, named aquarela.mid). It is a Soft Karaoke file whose own text says 'Karaokê do Brasil - Família Ribeiro - 1999'.
